name: Sears and Zemansky's University Physics with Modern Physics (14th Edition) - Loose Leaf with Binder
description: Essential textbook for STEM, physics, and engineering majors! Selling the loose-leaf (Books a la Carte) edition of Sears and Zemansky's University Physics with Modern Physics, 14th Edition by Hugh D. Young and Roger A. Freedman. This format is incredibly convenient as you can pull out just the chapters you need for class instead of hauling a massive 6-pound hardcover across campus. The complete set of pages is neatly pre-sorted and securely housed inside a sturdy white three-ring binder, saving you the hassle of organizing them yourself. All pages are clean, intact, and readable. Please note: This comes from a cat-friendly student apartment; while the textbook was kept safe inside a storage box and remains completely odor-free, a stray faint pet trace might exist on the binder surface. Perfect budget saver for the upcoming semester!
